text:
In October 2020 our record concentrates on one name. Seventy-seven of us said "amy coney barrett," peaking on 2020-10-26. Sixty-four said "judge amy coney," and sixty-two said "judge amy coney barrett," both peaking the same day, 2020-10-26. Fifty-nine of us said "amy coney barrett to." Fifty-five said "the supreme court," and fifty-one said "judge amy coney barrett to."

The court framed the rest. Thirty-nine of us said "the united states supreme court," and thirty-nine said "to the supreme court."

The phrase "amy coney barrett" first appeared on 2017-09-06. "Judge amy coney barrett to" first appeared on 2020-09-23, first said by Andy Biggs. On 2020-10-26 the counts converge. We report the convergence; we do not explain it. The record shows what we repeated, and on which day, together.
